theorem_summary.name: plain_lrat_extraction_trichotomy
theorem_summary.measured_object: support set output by an extractor that sees only untyped clauses and LRAT antecedent hints
theorem_summary.positive_side: adding variable-role provenance, clause provenance, or a support-locality checker leaves the plain-trace setting and supplies the audited object
theorem_summary.conservative_side: role-agnostic soundness for every semantic lift forces the extractor to output all variables on the unit-plus-blocking skeleton
theorem_summary.negative_side: a strict-subset output is falsified by the label lift of the same raw LRAT skeleton
theorem_summary.consequence: plain unaudited LRAT/DRAT syntax alone gives no nontrivial support-extraction normalizer
